headline: AICM reported 70 flights affected by situation in the United States
summary: Mexico City's international airport reported complications on 70 scheduled flights, including those of Mexican and US airlines. The disruption followed telecommunications problems in the US on Friday.
why: Airline operations depend on telecommunications and air traffic systems, so disruptions can raise costs for carriers and airports.
original_headline: AICM reportó 70 vuelos afectados por coyuntura en Estados Unidos
